description: LIVE: CISA's newest security advisories (CSAF: industrial control systems, medical devices, general vulnerabilities), each with its ID, affected vendors, CVEs, CVSS, the opening of CISA's mitigation text and the CISA link. Use for 'what did CISA advise this week' or 'any CISA advisory for <vendor>'. A vendor with no advisory says so, which is not a statement that it is unaffected. Deterministic: no model in the loop.

vendor.description: Optional. Vendor name or part of it, e.g. 'Siemens', 'Rockwell'.
